q1: SELECT beer.name, min_price, bar FROM beer LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT beer, MIN(price) AS min_price FROM serves GROUP BY beer) AS t ON beer.name = t.beer LEFT OUTER JOIN serves ON beer.name = serves.beer AND min_price = serves.price
q2: WITH ValidBeers AS (SELECT beer FROM serves WHERE serves.bar IN (SELECT bar FROM frequents WHERE drinker LIKE 'B%') GROUP BY beer HAVING COUNT(bar) >= 2), BeerPrices AS (SELECT serves.beer, serves.price FROM serves FULL OUTER JOIN ValidBeers ON serves.beer = ValidBeers.beer) SELECT bp.beer, MAX(bp.price) - MIN(bp.price) AS price_gap, AVG(bp.price) AS avg_price FROM BeerPrices AS bp GROUP BY bp.beer ORDER BY bp.beer
